The strongest direct mappings found in this pass are niche electrical equipment, thermal-management, UPS/battery backup, and integration services companies. This pass expands the AI theme into the scarce, execution-constrained parts of the data-center buildout: electrical balance-of-plant, cooling, substations, grid interconnection, and project delivery.
